notes: arXiv v1 (24 Oct 2025) PDF fetched from https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.21585. OpenAlex/Crossref return no DOI for this preprint, so doi is null and the arXiv abs page is the canonical URL. The paper's own footer identifies it as NeurIPS 2025; no publisher DOI was resolvable at retrieval time. Licence read directly from the abs-license block on the arXiv abs page, which links http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/ -- i.e. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, not arXiv's default non-exclusive licence. CC BY-NC-ND permits verbatim redistribution with attribution for non-commercial use, so the PDF is archived. The schema vocabulary has no CC-BY-NC-ND token; preprint-cc-arxiv is used as the leading token with the actual licence in a parenthetical qualifier. NoDerivatives caveat: a markdown conversion is arguably a derivative work, which CC BY-NC-ND does not grant, so source.md is retained as internal research notes under fair use rather than under the licence grant -- the same footing as a paywalled paper's extraction. Only the verbatim PDF rests on the licence itself. source.md produced by markitdown; the two-column PDF converts to heavily de-spaced text and spurious markdown tables, hence md_quality: rough. Numbers quoted on the card were read against the PDF's own tables, not the collapsed text. EXTRACTION UPDATE 2026-08-01 -- source.md was regenerated with pymupdf4llm, which preserves markdown tables and inter-word spacing that the earlier markitdown conversion destroyed, and md_quality was reassessed against the new extraction as clean (was rough).
